pages.title: Reusable Code
pages.content: Functions let you wrap code into reusable blocks. Define a function with the `def` keyword, followed by the function name and parentheses. Call it by using its name with `()`.

pages.title: Your First Function
pages.content: Define once, call as many times as you want:
pages.code:
def greet():
    print("Hello!")
    print("Welcome to Python.")

# Call the function
greet()
greet()  # Call it again!

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: Which keyword defines a function in Python?
pages.explanation: The def keyword is used to define a function in Python.
